summary: Enhance your research skills with our International Research Design course. Learn data collection, processing, and analysis techniques for global studies.
lede: Research design connects organizational questions to suitable methods, samples, evidence collection, and analysis. For professionals who plan or manage evidence for decisions, the course covers framing measurable questions, building sampling plans and instruments, and preparing and interpreting data. Learners practise data-quality checks, descriptive and introductory inferential analysis, thematic coding, and clear reporting of limitations.
audienceIntro: Research Design Training suits professionals who plan, supervise, collect, process, analyze, or commission evidence for organizational decisions. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured workflow rather than advanced statistical engineering.
prerequisites: You should have basic workplace experience with spreadsheets, written reports, or project documentation. No programming background is required, and the course uses guided Excel workflows with an introductory view of R rather than software engineering. You should bring a laptop if possible. Advanced statistical modelling, production database administration, and specialized research software configuration sit outside the course scope.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
